About

I’m a detail-oriented graphic and production designer with 2 years of experience in the tile manufacturing industry. Alongside design, I do photography and video production.

I work mainly in Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator, and I also use Blender, Affinity, and DaVinci Resolve.
